text: The entire protocol-supported content consists of **one experiment**: a three-step role-reconfiguration intervention applied to two dormant conversations from two model families, conducted by one human operator inside one live research project, with one observation per condition and no replication. Four further observations were preserved but not designed. Everything else — the conceptual framework, the practitioner observations, the structural hypothesis, the design rules — is **[R]** or **[H]**.
